english.note: Use this colloquial pattern with resource nouns such as 錢, 時間, and 位 when saying that there is enough of something.

exampleSentences.english: We have enough money to take a taxi home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋夠錢搭的士返屋企。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gau3 cin4 daap3 dik1 si2 faan1 uk1 kei2

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern when the noun is something being consumed, used, or obtained in a sufficient amount.
